intro: War destroyed much of Syria's economy, which once rested on farming, oil and trade.

chapters.title: Before the war
text: Syria grew wheat, cotton and olives and produced some oil. Aleppo was an industrial and trading centre.

chapters.title: Rebuilding
text: Cities, power stations and farms need rebuilding. Many sanctions were lifted in 2025, which may help recovery.

keyTerms.meaning: Penalties that limit trade with a country.

cardGroups.title: Made in Syria
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Syria makes and sells to the world.
